pages.title: Choose on Joining
pages.text: When the server enables classes, your first join opens a class selector. Choose a class to inspect its starting points, skills, items, and attributes, then confirm. You wait in spectator mode at your starting position until your choice is accepted.

pages.title: Keep What You Have
pages.text: Starter points and skill ranks add to existing progression. Starter armor equips automatically; displaced gear moves to inventory. Extra supplies enter inventory or wait in a saved overflow queue until you make room.

pages.title: One Starting Package
pages.text: Starting rewards are granted once. Death, reconnecting, and a server restart preserve your class without repeating its items. Ordinary progression resets keep the class choice and pending supplies; they can remove its originally granted points and skills.

pages.title: Return to Play
pages.text: After choosing, the server restores your previous game mode. Disconnecting during selection does not lose that mode. Operators can disable mandatory selection with classSelectorEnabled; this releases waiting players and preserves already chosen classes.

pages.title: Class Preview
pages.text: Choose a class icon from the top strip. Scroll it for more classes. The center preview wears starter armor; hover a body part for its item tooltip. Starting skills appear left, inventory right, and attributes below. Previous and Next cycle classes; Choose confirms.
